name: Cyclomatic complexity
description: Flags functions/events whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds a configurable threshold. A configured error threshold below the warning one is treated as equal to it.
definition: Flags functions/events whose cyclomatic complexity (1 plus each `If`/`ElseIf` branch, `While` loop, and short-circuiting `&&`/`||` operator) exceeds a configurable threshold, as a `[warning]` above `cyclomatic_complexity_warning` (default 10) or an `[error]` above `cyclomatic_complexity_error` (default 20); `cyclomatic_complexity_error` configured below `cyclomatic_complexity_warning` is treated as equal to it, since a lower error threshold would otherwise contradict the warning one it's supposed to escalate.
